policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV 'if need be' renders the participle δέον alike whether or not the copula ἐστίν stands with it; the only verse note is classed alternative_rendering ('Or, temptations') and bears on τειρασμοῖς, not on this unit.

ASV 'more precious than gold' is a plain comparative that suits either the compound πολυτιμότερον or the two-word πολὺ τιμιώτερον; the reading differs only in word division and the ASV supplies no intensifier that would separate them.
ASV 'unto praise and glory and honor' puts glory before honor, the order of δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν; the RP reading τιμὴν καὶ εἰς δόξαν would yield honor first and repeat the preposition before glory.
ASV 'whom not having seen ye love' renders ἰδόντes (seeing); εἰδότες would be 'not having known'.
ASV 'ye rejoice greatly' renders the middle ἀγαλλιᾶσθε and the active ἀγαλλιᾶτε identically; the verse's only note is a greek_gloss on 'full of glory'.
ASV 'the end of your faith' renders the possessive ὑμῶν, which the omitting reading lacks.
ASV renders 'by the Holy Spirit' and glosses it 'Greek in.', a gloss that presupposes the preposition ἐν in the underlying text; a bare dative πνεύματι ἁγίῳ rendered 'by' would need no such note.
The ὅτι is recitative before the quotation and goes untranslated in ASV 'because it is written, Ye shall be holy'; its presence or absence leaves the English unchanged.
ASV 'Ye shall be holy' renders the future indicative ἔσεσθε; γίνεσθε would give an imperative 'become/be ye holy'.
ASV 'for I am holy' is the ordinary rendering of the verbless ἐγὼ ἅγιος as well as of ἅγιος εἰμι; the copula in English does not show whether εἰμι stood in the Greek.
ASV 'at the end of the times' makes a singular substantive govern 'of the times', matching the singular ἐσχάτου; the plural ἐσχάτων agrees with χρόνων and would yield 'in the last times'.
ASV 'are believers in God' renders the adjective/substantive πιστούς; the participle πιστεύοντας would give 'believing in God'.
ASV 'in your obedience to the truth unto unfeigned love of the brethren' has nothing answering to διὰ πνεύματος, which the RP reading would require as 'through the Spirit'.
ASV's text reads 'from the heart fervently' without 'clean', and its textual_variant note on this verse relegates καθαρᾶς to the margin: 'Many ancient authorities read from a clean heart.'
ASV 'which liveth and abideth' ends without 'for ever', so εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα is unrepresented; the verse's other note is an alternative_rendering about 'God who liveth'.
ASV 'all the glory thereof' renders the feminine pronoun αὐτῆς referring back to flesh/grass; ἀνθρώπου would give 'the glory of man'.
ASV 'and the flower falleth' has no possessive answering to αὐτοῦ, which would yield 'the flower thereof'.
